description: Malicious code was discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz, starting with version 5.6.0. Through a series of complex obfuscations, the liblzma build process extracts a prebuilt test file contained within the source code, which modified the openSSH sshd function.
remediation: Downgrade xz-utils to version 5.4.6 or update to 5.6.1+ where compromised build scripts have been purged.

description: Heap buffer overflow in libwebp in Google Chrome and WebP decoder allowed remote attackers to perform an out of bounds memory write via a crafted HTML page.
This flaw makes curl overflow a heap based buffer in the SOCKS5 proxy handshake, allowing remote code execution under specific network configurations.
remediation: Upgrade curl to version 8.4.0 or disable SOCKS5 proxy hostname resolution.

description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints (Log4Shell).
remediation: Upgrade log4j-core to 2.17.1 or set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true.

description: runc internal file descriptor leak (WORKDIR break-out) vulnerability allowing container escape to host root filesystem.
remediation: Upgrade runc to version 1.1.12 or later.
